title: TOP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Texture operators, covering texture dimensions, pixel format and memory, pixel sampling, NumPy and CUDA readback, file saving, byte-array export, and inherited OP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python needs to inspect or export TOP images, sample pixels, or bridge TOP data into NumPy/CUDA workflows.
Use width, height, aspect, and pixelFormat for resolution-aware plans instead of parsing parameters from specific TOP operators.
numpyArray(delayed=True) avoids immediate GPU stalls but returns the previous available result, so validators must handle None on the first call.
Use save() for filesystem export and saveByteArray() when the image should stay in memory.
Remember that writing to a NumPy array returned from a TOP does not change the TOP texture.
